provider: UCSB Climate Hazards Center, mirrored by Digital Earth Africa
attribution: Funk et al. (2015), CHIRPS v2.0, UCSB Climate Hazards Center
validation: Per-month means must differ across bands (the seasonal cycle). Compare a band with the mean of the same calendar month's raw COGs over a few years.
notes: Values are calendar-month means over the period, not a trend.
Anomalies in the app compare the same calendar days with this baseline.
